reason: Source v1.24.0 already caps local RisingWave memory (2 GiB single_node budget, Docker limit 1 GiB above it, compactor limit from a mounted config), so the older 2 GiB container / 1.5 GiB budget hunk is not ported. What the local fixture still needs: the ephemeral state store (removed by raftdev stop anyway) in a 2 GiB tmpfs, added to the container limit. On a shared data disk the checkpoint fsyncs made each materialized view of the 54-step bootstrap take minutes longer than the previous one. Web, seed and queries unchanged.
